question: Do fresh Basic 4.9b observations retain the ordering and scores of the prior 91-percent incumbent and 100-percent rejected candidate?
selection_limitation: This case was selected after its prior result was known. The diagnostic assesses two observations per fixed text over time; it does not estimate a stable detector error distribution, causal writing-rule effect, transfer, human authorship, or general success rate.
entry_transform: Source minus at most one terminal LF; retain literal submission and verify effective editor bytes separately. The prior Code Block wrapper added exactly three LF characters. Stop before submission if the current transform changes substantive text.
completion_rule: Complete both scans regardless of the first score. Stop dependent submissions only for hash/quality/mode/model mismatch, insufficient full-pair allowance, account or quota change, or unreconciled failure. A timeout must be reconciled without resubmitting. Preserve every failure and partial pair.
decision: This diagnostic cannot promote a writing rule or unlock prior holdouts under any outcome. Use it only to identify whether same-input variation is an unresolved limitation before future adequately funded experiments.
